exactly 16 float32 predicted mesh frames with fixed faces, frame/timestamp IDs and query_vertex_ids

outputs: full original-identity mesh sequence at every original frame

planned_math_to_code.statement: Receipt-bound adjacent sparse geometry kernels and the frame-0 area law define the finite-state reference path law Q.
KL stationarity gives P*(path)=u(i_0)Q(path)v(i_T), and sparse forward/backward messages compute its endpoint marginals without path enumeration.
Alternate endpoint scaling until both marginal residuals close.
Sparse bridge policies define the whole-path conditional coordinate mean without a dense endpoint matrix.

geometry_only_specialization.state_space: original query vertex IDs shared by all 16 predicted frames
forbidden_inputs: external correspondence, cost or Markov kernels
geometry_only_specialization.claim_boundary: The sparse policies are geometry decisions, not recovered natural or semantic correspondence.

reference_chain.support: descriptor kNN union exact original-ID edges plus explicit strict positive area- and uniform-feasibility witnesses; the uniform witness only closes the frozen shared support and is not an endpoint law

endpoint_marginals.strictness: every retained state must have positive finite incident area; otherwise C08 fails closed

support_and_reachability.certificate: each adjacent support retains a strictly positive coupling with the two adjacent area marginals
support_and_reachability.consequence: the product of adjacent witness conditionals is an explicit finite-KL path law with the required endpoints
support_and_reachability.structural_zeros: support-external edges remain zero; no dense epsilon or large-weight repair

log_bridge_solver.objective: minimize KL(P||Q) subject to fixed initial and terminal marginals
log_bridge_solver.acceptance: both maximum absolute and relative endpoint residuals meet the frozen tolerance before max_iterations

whole_path_decision_and_lift.rule: for frame s and original state i, emit E[X_s(I_s)|I_0=i] under the complete bridge policy product
whole_path_decision_and_lift.implementation: backward sparse policy products; no dense V-by-V endpoint matrix or path enumeration
whole_path_decision_and_lift.anchor: frame 0 is copied bit-exactly; faces, query IDs and frame IDs are unchanged

certificates: endpoint scaling residual trace and bridge row/terminal residuals
hard-path diagnostics separated from probabilistic endpoint closure
float32 finite output, exact anchor and fixed native identity arrays
failure_semantics: Receipt mismatch, topology/identity drift, nonpositive area, infeasible support/witness, nonconvergence, nonfinite output or certificate mismatch is retained as terminal failed_unscored/error evidence. No B0 substitution and no retry of the frozen scientific attempt.
limitations: Predicted geometry supplies a legal specialization but not semantic identity supervision.
The conditional-mean mesh is a Bayes coordinate action; probability endpoint closure does not imply its diagnostic hard-state histogram matches the endpoint marginal.
All source and tests are generated_unexecuted until Local acceptance; no native result or scientific conclusion exists.
